title: Japan Tour Package
summary: A journey that blends tradition with modernity across Tokyo, Kyoto, Nara and Osaka — historic temples, bamboo groves, deer parks and vibrant city life.
highlights: Optional: kimono dress-up, tea ceremony, sushi-making, onsen visits

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Airport transfer and hotel check-in, with optional evening activities.

itinerary.title: Tokyo City Tour
itinerary.description: Asakusa Temple, Tokyo Skytree/Tower, Meiji Shrine, Harajuku and Shinjuku.

itinerary.title: Mt. Fuji & Hakone Day Tour
itinerary.description: Mount Fuji 5th Station, Lake Ashi cruise and the Hakone Ropeway.

itinerary.title: Bullet Train to Kyoto
itinerary.description: Shinkansen ride to Kyoto, Fushimi Inari Shrine and the Gion district.

itinerary.title: Kyoto Cultural Tour
itinerary.description: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion), Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and an optional tea ceremony.

itinerary.title: Nara Day Trip + Transfer to Osaka
itinerary.description: Todai-ji Temple, Nara Deer Park and Kasuga Taisha Shrine, then on to Osaka.

itinerary.title: Osaka City Tour
itinerary.description: Osaka Castle, Umeda Sky Building, Dotonbori and Shinsaibashi.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Hotel check-out and airport transfer to Kansai International (KIX).

title: Georgia & Armenia Tour Package
summary: Explore the hidden gems of the Caucasus — from Tbilisi's vibrant streets and snow-capped Kazbegi to ancient Armenian monasteries and Lake Sevan.
highlights: Tbilisi city tour with cable car and Sulphur Baths
Georgian Military Highway and Gergeti Trinity Church
Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery and Lake Sevan

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Airport transfer, hotel check-in and a free evening to explore.

itinerary.title: Tbilisi City Tour
itinerary.description: Holy Trinity Cathedral, Metekhi Church, Narikala Fortress, cable car ride, Sulphur Baths and the Bridge of Peace.

itinerary.title: Gudauri – Kazbegi
itinerary.description: Georgian Military Highway, Ananuri Fortress, Zhinvali Reservoir and Gergeti Trinity Church (optional 4x4).

itinerary.title: Armenia Border Crossing – Yerevan
itinerary.description: Border assistance, vehicle and guide change, with a stop at Haghpat Monastery.

itinerary.title: Yerevan City Tour
itinerary.description: Republic Square, Cascade Complex, Matenadaran, Vernissage Market and Tsitsernakaberd Memorial.

itinerary.title: Garni – Geghard – Lake Sevan
itinerary.description: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery and Sevanavank Monastery.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Yerevan
itinerary.description: Shopping, museums, or an optional wine / Khor Virap tour.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Hotel check-out and airport transfer.

title: Bali Tour Package
summary: Bali's cultural heart in Ubud, the island scenery of Nusa Penida and the nightlife of Kuta & Seminyak — suited to honeymooners, families and independent travellers.
highlights: Tegenungan Waterfall and Ubud Art Market
Monkey Forest and a Luwak coffee plantation visit
Nusa Penida tour — Broken Beach, Angel's Billabong, Kelingking Beach
Uluwatu Temple with a traditional Kecak Dance
Optional water sports at Tanjung Benoa

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali – Kuta
itinerary.description: Airport transfer, hotel check-in and a free evening at Kuta Beach.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Ubud & Kintamani Tour
itinerary.description: Waterfalls, art markets, Monkey Forest, a coffee plantation and volcano views.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour
itinerary.description: Boat excursion to three beaches, lunch included.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Temple + Sunset
itinerary.description: Temple visit, Kecak Dance and an optional beach dinner.

itinerary.title: Tanah Lot Temple & Bali Swing
itinerary.description: Bali Swing, Taman Ayun Temple and the iconic sea temple at sunset.

itinerary.title: Free Day
itinerary.description: Optional water sports, shopping or spa time.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Hotel check-out and airport transfer.

title: Russia Tour Package
summary: An 8-day tour of Moscow and St. Petersburg — iconic landmarks, imperial palaces, a high-speed train between the capitals and English-speaking guides.
highlights: Red Square, St. Basil's Cathedral and Lenin's Mausoleum
Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood

itinerary.title: Arrival in Moscow
itinerary.description: Airport transfer, hotel check-in and an optional evening walk.

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour
itinerary.description: Red Square, St. Basil's, the Kremlin, Sparrow Hills and Arbat Street.

itinerary.title: Metro Tour + Free Time
itinerary.description: Metro stations tour, with optional markets and parks in your free time.

itinerary.title: High-Speed Train to St. Petersburg
itinerary.description: Sapsan train journey, hotel transfer and a walk along Nevsky Prospect.

itinerary.title: St. Petersburg City Tour
itinerary.description: Hermitage Museum, cathedrals, Palace Square and Peter and Paul Fortress.

itinerary.title: Peterhof Palace & Gardens
itinerary.description: Day trip to Peterhof, the Lower Gardens and the Grand Palace.

itinerary.title: Free Day or Optional Tour
itinerary.description: Optional Catherine Palace visit or a canal cruise.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Hotel check-out and airport transfer.

title: UK Tour Package
summary: Royal heritage, historic landmarks and countryside scenery across London, Windsor, Oxford, Stonehenge, Bath and Edinburgh.
highlights: Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, London Eye, Tower of London and Buckingham Palace
Changing of the Guard ceremony and Tower Bridge
Roman Baths and the city of Bath
Edinburgh Castle, Holyrood Palace and Arthur's Seat
Optional Warner Bros Studio Tour (Harry Potter)

itinerary.title: Arrival in London
itinerary.description: Airport transfer, with the evening free for shopping or a Thames cruise.

itinerary.title: London City Tour
itinerary.description: Guided tour of Big Ben, Westminster, the London Eye, Tower of London, Buckingham Palace and the Guard ceremony.

itinerary.title: Windsor, Stonehenge & Bath
itinerary.description: Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and the Roman Baths.

itinerary.title: Oxford & Cotswolds
itinerary.description: Oxford University colleges and traditional English villages.

itinerary.title: Free Day / Optional Studio Tour
itinerary.description: Shopping at Oxford Street or Harrods, or the optional Harry Potter studio tour.

itinerary.title: London to Edinburgh
itinerary.description: High-speed train to Scotland and a walk along the Royal Mile.

itinerary.title: Edinburgh City Tour
itinerary.description: Edinburgh Castle, Holyrood Palace, Arthur's Seat and museums.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Hotel check-out and airport transfer.

exclusions: Optional activities (Thames cruise, Warner Bros tour)

title: Paris, France Tour Package
summary: Paris's most iconic landmarks — the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, Montmartre and Versailles — with optional Disneyland Paris.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paris
itinerary.description: Airport arrival, private transfer and an optional Seine River Cruise.

itinerary.title: Paris City Tour + Eiffel Tower
itinerary.description: Guided tour of the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Élysées and Notre-Dame, with a leisure afternoon.

itinerary.title: Louvre Museum & Montmartre
itinerary.description: Louvre visit with skip-the-line access and Montmartre exploration; optional Moulin Rouge.

itinerary.title: Versailles Palace Tour
itinerary.description: Royal apartments and the Hall of Mirrors, with free time in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Optional Disneyland / Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Full-day Disneyland Paris visit, or leisure shopping and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Hotel check-out and airport transfer.
